mapper.select: SELECT oi.order_item_no AS orderItemNo, oi.item_name AS itemName, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice, oi.order_item_status AS orderItemStatus, img.image_url AS imageUrl, oi.product_option_no AS productOptionNo, oi.item_size AS optionSize, oi.item_color AS optionColor, o.orderer_name AS ordererName, o.created_at AS createdAt, o.total_price AS totalPrice FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_item oi ON o.order_no = oi.order_no INNER JOIN product_option po ON oi.product_option_no = po.product_option_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_no, image_url FROM ( SELECT pi.product_no, pi.image_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY pi.product_no ORDER BY pi.sort_order ASC, pi.product_img_no ASC ) AS rn FROM product_img pi WHERE pi.image_type = 'THUMB' ) ranked_img WHERE rn = 1 ) img ON po.product_no = img.product_no WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY oi.order_item_no ASC
SELECT order_item_status FROM order_item WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY order_item_no ASC
SELECT o.member_no FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_no = o.order_no WHERE oi.order_item_no = #{orderItemNo}
